title: A missing gate report is never treated as an implicit pass
asA: reviewer trusting the aggregate report as the sole ledger of what actually ran
iWant: the aggregate verdict to be `failed` on any missing required gate report
soThat: a runner crash, an unhandled exception, or a write failure cannot be indistinguishable from success

acceptanceCriteria.description: The aggregate report records the fixed configured set of required gates as its `gates[]` array in configured order. A required gate whose per-gate report file was not written during the run is recorded in the array with `outcome: missing` and a `reason` field naming the failure mode.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a suite invocation in which the `coverage-strict` gate's Node child process was killed before its report could be written (or the report directory was not writable, or the child exited with an uncaught exception)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the aggregate report is written at the end of the run
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report's `gates[]` array contains a `coverage-strict` entry with `outcome: missing`, its `reason` field carries a non-empty string, and the aggregate `verdict` is `failed`

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Node entry point's process exit code is non-zero when any required gate's outcome is `missing`, even if no gate outcome is `failed`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a suite invocation whose required-gate set has one gate outcome `missing` and every other outcome `passed`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exit code is non-zero, and the aggregate report's `verdict` is `failed`
